title: SC1-#4717350-v1-Comments_to_CFO_8-K_8_8_2018_v1 compared with SC1-#4717350-v3-Comments_to_CFO_8-K_8_8_2018_v1
主要内容: DISH Network Corporation through its subsidiary American II acquired 80% of Northstar Manager’s Class B Common Interests for $312 million. DISH owns 97% of Northstar Spectrum’s Class B Common Interests, with Northstar Manager holding 3%. Northstar Manager did not exercise its Put Right during the First Put Window (2020–2021), retaining the right to do so in the Second Put Window (2021–2022). Northstar Wireless, a subsidiary of Northstar Spectrum, participated in Auction 97 and received 261 AWS-3 Licenses in 2015. The FCC ruled in 2020 that Northstar Wireless and SNR Wireless remain under DISH Network’s de facto control, prompting appeals to the D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals. The transaction did not alter existing arrangements between Northstar parties, except for ownership percentages.
